extracted.name: The Rusty Nail Cocktail
extracted.description: Smoky Scotch gets sweetened up with the addition of Drambuie in the classic drink called the rusty nail.
instruction_lines: Place 2 large ice cubes in a rocks class. Set aside in the freezer.
Combine Scotch and Drambuie in a cocktail mixing glass. Add 1/2 cup ice and stir until chilled. Strain into the chilled rocks glass.
